cases.scenario: S1 no deal after three rounds
cases.requirement: S1; D-029; D-031 ceiling disclosure 0 and correct no-deal outcome
cases.detail: Three nondecreasing counters ended in no_deal without a ceiling disclosure.

cases.scenario: S2 deal, reserve, transfer, end, release
cases.requirement: S2; D-029; reservation is held and transferred without TMS confirmation
cases.detail: Outcome was reserved; the hold was transferred and then released with the ops token.

cases.requirement: Standard walk-away; a pitched call ends as no_deal
cases.detail: Pitched call ended with no_deal and no reservation or transfer.

cases.requirement: S3; inactive authority is rejected before verification
cases.detail: Carrier check returned not_eligible and no code was sent.

cases.requirement: S4; unknown MC is handled without verification
cases.detail: Carrier check returned not_found and no code was sent.

cases.requirement: S9; an empty board search ends with no_match
cases.detail: Empty search returned count 0 and the recorded outcome was no_match.

cases.requirement: S6; three wrong codes lock the call and load search remains gated
cases.detail: Third wrong code locked the call; search returned 403 not_verified.

cases.scenario: Garbage code does not consume an attempt
cases.requirement: Verification edge; unclear input preserves all three attempts
cases.detail: Input abc returned unclear with three attempts left.

cases.requirement: S5; service-side verification gate refuses load search
cases.detail: Search returned HTTP 403 not_verified before any code was sent.

cases.scenario: Verified carrier identity cannot be reused
cases.requirement: Audit 4.1; changing MC clears identity state and requires a new code
cases.detail: MC change blocked search, negotiation, and reservation until the replacement carrier completed its own code check.

cases.requirement: Audit 4.4; restarting negotiation cannot reset the three-counter limit
cases.detail: After three counters, a new negotiation start returned closed and no reservation was created.

cases.requirement: Audit 4.5; MAX_BUY below posted rate is refused and logged
cases.detail: QA_INCONSISTENT_LOAD_ID is not configured; no staging TMS record was changed

cases.requirement: Reservation guard; no hold exists until negotiation records agreement
cases.detail: Reservation returned no_agreed_price before any offer was accepted.

cases.requirement: Transfer guard; only a live reservation may transfer
Call finalization; a repeated end cannot change the outcome
cases.detail: Second end_call returned OK and the outcome remained no_match.

cases.requirement: Strict schemas reject agent-supplied agreement and ceiling values
cases.detail: Both unknown-field requests returned HTTP 400 invalid_request.

cases.requirement: D-029 security layer; workflow, ops, and absent credentials are isolated
cases.detail: Wrong scopes returned 403; missing credentials returned 401; no confirmation request was sent.

cases.requirement: D-024 hidden delivery is one-time and returns no second code
cases.detail: Second delivery returned nothing_to_deliver and exposed no code.

cases.requirement: S7; D-031 ceiling disclosed 0 across every agent-facing response
cases.detail: Scanned 96 agent-facing responses; no forbidden key or documented ceiling value appeared.
